messages.subject: Saudi Leadership Profile | Government Relations, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear MenaTalents Team,

Your Saudi-based executive-search and HR advisory platform, including C-suite hiring, government-relations support and leadership appointments across the Kingdom, makes this a highly relevant introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications in a major natural-resources environment.

Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership mandates where institutional relationships, regulatory discipline, responsible development and cross-functional execution are central to business performance. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for current or future mandates.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
